environment: WSL Ubuntu 22.04; g++ 11.4.0; CMake 3.22.1; OpenCV 4.5.4; Release build
method: Isolated exporter using the submitted processing body. GUI and waiting disabled; startup slider values fixed. Annotated frames recorded without changing detection or PnP calculations.
limitations: Candidate frequency is not accuracy/recall; no real-distance ground truth; timing in this export excludes GUI updates and is not presented as a live GUI benchmark.

demonstration.composition: 752 original frames followed by 148 explicitly REPLAY-labeled frames from the beginning.
